text: You see a Regulator, one of the guards of Adytum.
source_text: You see a Regulator, one of the guards of Adytum.

text: Keep your weapons under control while you're here.
source_text: Keep your weapons under control while you're here.

text: Welcome to Adytum, stranger. Watch yourself, we'll be watching you.
source_text: Welcome to Adytum, stranger. Watch yourself, we'll be watching you.

text: Can I ask you a few questions?
source_text: Can I ask you a few questions?

text: Zimmerman might have a use for you. Come inside, but# remember, we're watching.
source_text:
Zimmerman might have a use for you. Come inside, but
# remember, we're watching.

text: Welcome back! You're welcome here any time.
source_text: Welcome back! You're welcome here any time.

text: Don't you have a job to do? Come back here when you've# dealt with the it.
source_text:
Don't you have a job to do? Come back here when you've
# dealt with the it.

text: What do you want to know about?
source_text: What do you want to know about?

text: Can you tell me more about the Boneyard?
source_text: Can you tell me more about the Boneyard?

text: What do you know about the Children of the Cathedral# and the Followers of the Apocalypse?
source_text:
What do you know about the Children of the Cathedral
# and the Followers of the Apocalypse?

text: I'm one of the Regulators. It's our job to keep the peace# in Adytum, and to protect the town. Our boss, Caleb,# could tell you more.
source_text:
I'm one of the Regulators. It's our job to keep the peace
# in Adytum, and to protect the town. Our boss, Caleb,
# could tell you more.

text: East of us are the Followers. They are a bunch of peace-nuts.# East are the Blade, a bunch of Skags if you ask me. A ways south of here is the #Cathedral, #where the Children have their religious center.
source_text:
East of us are the Followers. They are a bunch of peace-nuts.
# East are the Blade, a bunch of Skags if you ask me. A ways south of here is the #Cathedral, 
#where the Children have their religious center.

text: Sorry, but we have to be careful of strangers here. Too# dangerous. Maybe you can do some work for Zimmerman.
source_text:
Sorry, but we have to be careful of strangers here. Too
# dangerous. Maybe you can do some work for Zimmerman.

text: You're welcome here anytime, of course!
source_text: You're welcome here anytime, of course!

text: They're both groups of nuts. The Followers want everyone to be# peaceful and happy. They don't realize that the world is too# harsh for that.
source_text:
They're both groups of nuts. The Followers want everyone to be
# peaceful and happy. They don't realize that the world is too
# harsh for that.

text: The Children have some sort of god they worship# in their Cathedral to the south. They have a hospital, # but they're a little too weird to be on the level.
source_text:
The Children have some sort of god they worship
# in their Cathedral to the south. They have a hospital, 
# but they're a little too weird to be on the level.

text: You were warned to keep your weapons under control!
source_text: You were warned to keep your weapons under control!

text: You'd better put your weapons away while you're here.
source_text: You'd better put your weapons away while you're here.

text: A thief, eh? Let me show you what we do to your kind here!
source_text: A thief, eh? Let me show you what we do to your kind here!

text: I guess this means we're done with you, old man.
source_text: I guess this means we're done with you, old man.

text: It's a ways south of us.
source_text: It's a ways south of us.

text: They're on the north of here.
source_text: They're on the north of here.

text: They're to the east of the Blades, and then north of the Deathclaws.
source_text: They're to the east of the Blades, and then north of the Deathclaws.

text: Isn't that a city north of here?
source_text: Isn't that a city north of here?

text: Tine's store is underground near the gate.
source_text: Tine's store is underground near the gate.

text: They go outside to get things.
source_text: They go outside to get things.

text: 你看到一个小头目，内城区的守卫之一。
source_text: 你看到一个小头目，内城区的守卫之一。

text: 欢迎来到内城区，陌生人。老实点，我们会盯着你的。
source_text: 欢迎来到内城区，陌生人。老实点，我们会盯着你的。

text: 齐默曼可能会用到你。进来吧，但记住，我们盯着呢。
source_text: 齐默曼可能会用到你。进来吧，但记住，我们盯着呢。

text: 欢迎回来！这里随时都欢迎你。
source_text: 欢迎回来！这里随时都欢迎你。

text: 你不是有活干吗？干完活儿再回来。
source_text: 你不是有活干吗？干完活儿再回来。

text: 能再多告诉我一些关于晒骨场的事吗？
source_text: 能再多告诉我一些关于晒骨场的事吗？

text: 关于大教堂教徒和末世论者你都知道些什么？
source_text: 关于大教堂教徒和末世论者你都知道些什么？

text: 我是个小头目。我们的工作是维持内城区的和平，和保卫这个镇。我们的老板卡勒布会告诉你更多事情。
source_text: 我是个小头目。我们的工作是维持内城区的和平，和保卫这个镇。我们的老板卡勒布会告诉你更多事情。

text: 我们东部是末世论者。他们是狂热的和平主义者，疯子。东面是利刃帮，一群婊子。南边就是大教堂了，那些教徒的宗教集会中心。
source_text: 我们东部是末世论者。他们是狂热的和平主义者，疯子。东面是利刃帮，一群婊子。南边就是大教堂了，那些教徒的宗教集会中心。

text: 抱歉，对于陌生人我们必须留神，不然就有危险了。你也许可以为齐默曼做些事。
source_text: 抱歉，对于陌生人我们必须留神，不然就有危险了。你也许可以为齐默曼做些事。

text: 两帮都是疯子。末世论者希望大家一团和气，开开心心，却没有意识到这世界有多残忍。
source_text: 两帮都是疯子。末世论者希望大家一团和气，开开心心，却没有意识到这世界有多残忍。

text: 在南边的大教堂里教徒们在崇拜某种神。他们有医院，但是他们也有点太奇怪了，最好不要信任他们。
source_text: 在南边的大教堂里教徒们在崇拜某种神。他们有医院，但是他们也有点太奇怪了，最好不要信任他们。

text: 你已经被警告过要把武器收好。
source_text: 你已经被警告过要把武器收好。

text: 在这里，你最好把武器收起来。
source_text: 在这里，你最好把武器收起来。

text: 小偷，你是小偷啊。让你见识一下我们是怎么对付你这种贼的。
source_text: 小偷，你是小偷啊。让你见识一下我们是怎么对付你这种贼的。

text: 老头，我想我们不需要你了。
source_text: 老头，我想我们不需要你了。

text: 我可以告诉你：Adytum-内城区、Followers-末世论者、Cathedral-大教堂、Blades-利刃帮、Runners-军火商、Hub-哈勃、Junktown-迦克镇、Chip-芯片、Store-商店、Zimmerman-齐默曼、Necropolis-大墓地城、Glow闪光之地、Regulators-管理者、Scavs-拾荒者、Boneyard-晒骨场。
source_text: 我可以告诉你：Adytum-内城区、Followers-末世论者、Cathedral-大教堂、Blades-利刃帮、Runners-军火商、Hub-哈勃、Junktown-迦克镇、Chip-芯片、Store-商店、Zimmerman-齐默曼、Necropolis-大墓地城、Glow闪光之地、Regulators-管理者、Scavs-拾荒者、Boneyard-晒骨场。

text: 他们在利刃帮的东边，死亡爪的北边。
source_text: 他们在利刃帮的东边，死亡爪的北边。

text: 这的北边不是个城市吗？
source_text: 这的北边不是个城市吗？

text: 提恩的店铺在门口附近的地下。
source_text: 提恩的店铺在门口附近的地下。
